title: Subsets (Power Set)
tagline: Include-or-exclude each element — the simplest backtracking decision tree.

intuition.analogy: Packing for a trip, you go through each item and make one binary choice: pack it or leave it. Every distinct set of choices produces a different packing list — and all together they form every possible packing list.
paragraphs: The power set of n elements has 2^n subsets. Backtracking enumerates them by walking a decision tree: at each element you branch into 'exclude' and 'include', and a leaf (after deciding all n) is one subset.
The recursion maintains a current partial subset. Before recursing you add the element (include branch); after recursing you remove it (the 'backtrack' that restores state for the sibling branch).

This include/exclude skeleton generalises to combinations (with a start index to avoid reordering), combination sum, and any 'choose a subset satisfying a constraint' problem — making it the foundation of the whole backtracking family.
intuition.keyIdea: Each element contributes one binary decision; recursing over all decisions enumerates all 2^n subsets.

steps.title: Define the recursion
steps.detail: dfs(i, current): if i == n, record current; else branch.

steps.title: Two branches
steps.detail: Exclude: dfs(i+1, current). Include: add a[i], dfs(i+1, current), then remove a[i] (backtrack).

steps.title: Collect at leaves
steps.detail: Each complete path to depth n yields one subset; a copy is stored in the results.

code.title: subsets.py
code.source:
def subsets(a):
    res, cur = [], []
    def dfs(i):
        if i == len(a):
            res.append(cur[:])      # snapshot
            return
        dfs(i + 1)                  # exclude a[i]
        cur.append(a[i])            # include a[i]
        dfs(i + 1)
        cur.pop()                   # backtrack
    dfs(0)
    return res

complexity.timeReason: 2^n subsets, each costing O(n) to copy into the result.
complexity.spaceReason: Recursion depth and the current partial subset (output excluded).

pitfalls: Store a COPY of the current list — appending the live reference records future mutations.
Forgetting to pop after the include branch corrupts sibling branches.
For combinations (fixed size / no reordering), pass a start index instead of a binary include/exclude.

dryRun.clickMoment: Read the four leaves: they're exactly the binary numbers 00, 01, 10, 11. The decision tree IS the binary counter from 0 to 2^n − 1.
